The '''Cool Star''', added in [[Update Log|Update 17]], is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the [[Infinity Castle]] (10th Season).

As of 18/11/23, the day of [[Update Log|Update 18]], and the end of Season 10, the Cool Star could be opened to receive [[Fridge]].
